issue on [/] - [WCAG 2.0 AA, Success Criterion 1.4.3 (serious severity)]:
Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds.

Element: <h3 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-400 md:text-3xl">

Fix any of the following:
• Element has insufficient color contrast of 2.53 (foreground color: #9ca3af, background color: #ffffff, font size: 22.5pt (30px), font weight: bold). Expected contrast ratio of 3:1

Help: https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/color-contrast?application=axeAPI

issue on [/] - [WCAG 2.0 A, Success Criterion 2.4.2 (serious severity)]:
Documents must have <title> element to aid in navigation.

Element: <html lang="invalid">

Fix any of the following:
• Document does not have a non-empty <title> element

Help: https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/document-title?application=axeAPI

issue on [/] - [WCAG 2.0 A, Success Criterion 3.1.1 (serious severity)]:
<html> element must have a valid value for the lang attribute.

Element: <html lang="invalid">

Fix all of the following:
• Value of lang attribute not included in the list of valid languages

Help: https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/html-lang-valid?application=axeAPI

issue on [/] - [WCAG 2.0 A, Success Criterion 1.1.1 (critical severity)]: Images must have alternative text. Element: Fix any of the following: • Element does not have an alt attribute • aria-label attribute does not exist or is empty • aria-labelledby attribute does not exist, references elements that do not exist or references elements that are empty • Element has no title attribute • Element's default semantics were not overridden with role="none" or role="presentation" Help: https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/image-alt?application=axeAPI

issue on [/] - [WCAG 2.0 A, Success Criterion 2.4.4, Success Criterion 4.1.2 (serious severity)]:
Links must have discernible text.

Element: <a test-id="nav-link" href="https://github.com/PennyLaneAI/pennylane" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="text-gray-800 transition-colors duration-200 hover:text-slate-500">

Fix all of the following:
• Element is in tab order and does not have accessible text

Fix any of the following:
• Element does not have text that is visible to screen readers
• aria-label attribute does not exist or is empty
• aria-labelledby attribute does not exist, references elements that do not exist or references elements that are empty
• Element has no title attribute

Help: https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/link-name?application=axeAPI
